items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, he played wonderful, wonderful. Well, in fact, Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey, all of them came down and they'd sit in. We'd had a ball in that place.

ctx.x: In those days I was traveling around the country a lot. I was in the Depression and every time I'd come back to town, my friend would say, Steve Smith, say, you should have been here last week. Larry Shields sat in with the band. Yeah, yes. I never did get to hear Larry. Never in my life. He never? Only on record.
Oh, he played wonderful, wonderful. Well, in fact, Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey, all of them came down and they'd sit in. We'd had a ball in that place.

I'm sorry, most of all I missed Shields, the only chance I ever had to hear him. Then they got that Dixieland band together and traveled around the country and I just missed them in Memphis and I missed them down here about 1937. Yeah, I played with them. Yeah, you made some records then when La Rocca left.
